name: touch-s2i-go-up-300
description: #120 stretch 2 probe (owner hint: talk to a party member), generated by runner/test/unit/playthrough-scenarios.js from the touch layer; boots from touch-md1-1 (stretch 1's end, kept by touch-playthrough). Boots from touch-stall. Input: mark go; drag up (no Interact) for 300 frames; 10 still frames; Interact for 4 frames; 40 still frames. No wait, so nothing can zero the end checks. End check: md1_1 still (0x75). Metrics: n3, n3p256 (model 3's talk-rule distance sign, plus 0 / 256 field units), ax3_256 and ay3_256 (sign of |model 3 - Cloud| along PosX / PosY minus 256), w0 and w1 (raw window states at the end: 6 is a message waiting), cx and cy (sign of Cloud's PosX / PosY change since go). The near checks may fail by design. Only signs, frame counts and small state values leave.
